subject.title: Fix dashboard chat run recovery across reconnects

question: Should maintainers adopt/rewrite this stale conflicting branch, ask the contributor for a current-main rebase with proof, or close it after a replacement owns the linked Dashboard recovery issue?
rationale: The remaining blockers are not one narrow bot-repairable edit because current main has moved the protocol and chat lifecycle surfaces and the branch needs an ownership decision before repair work should proceed.

options.title: Adopt or replace on current main
options.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the useful recovery intent while using current filtered active-run helpers and restart-only shutdown semantics.

options.title: Ask contributor to rebase and prove
options.body: The original author can update the branch against current main and add redacted live Dashboard proof before another merge review.

options.title: Close after canonical replacement
options.body: If another PR becomes the viable fix path for the linked issue, this stale branch can be closed as superseded rather than kept as a landing candidate.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace on current main
recommendation.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the useful recovery intent while using current filtered active-run helpers and restart-only shutdown semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter owns the current-main chat lifecycle and session active-run refactor the branch must align with.
